messages:
emma: Hey team — final prep for the release announcement. Need changelog link, docs link, confirm rollout timing + embargo window. Landing post + webinar narrative should align. Can we lock by EOD? :clock3:

alex: Changelog PR is merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821. Short summary in PR body. Caveat: model card update pending (I'll push in 30m).

nina: Docs staging link: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-XX. Updated quickstart + migration note. Will add redirect once prod push is green.

raj: Webinar asks — want 1-week lead time. Proposed slot Wed 2026-03-31 10am PT. Marketing can push registration if we confirm features + A/B narrative.

sophia: Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 50% after 2h -> 100% after 24h, auto-fallback to v1 on error rate > 3%. Is that still accurate? Also need bench numbers for announcement (latency p95, cost delta).

alex: Confirmed rollout policy. Bench: p95 token latency 120ms on dedicated, cost ~0.8x previous model for same throughput. I'll paste mini table in a follow-up.

emma: Perfect — can you paste the bench blurb + a 1-2 sentence logline for the blog? Also need embargo window: propose 03/31 15:00 UTC.

alex: Blog line: "30% fewer GPU cycles and 20% lower per-token cost at similar quality." Bench blurb attached: p50 45ms / p95 120ms / cost 0.8x.

deploy-bot: schedule: release v2026.03.31 -> canary start 2390004600 (unix) ; auto-promote at +2h ; rollback on alert threshold.

emma: Great — locking this. I'll send embargo calendar invite and draft post. Thanks all :rocket:
